benchmarks.name: CSWE 2022 EPAS
benchmarks.scope: Competencies 1, 3, 4, 6–9. Ethical technology and supervision, inclusion, research-informed practice and engagement through evaluation. US degree accreditation comparator for supported scenarios.

benchmarks.name: CSWE 2029 EPAS Draft 1
benchmarks.scope: Emerging competency 10 frames ethical technology and AI selection. Draft consultation only, with a second draft expected in 2027.

benchmarks.name: DigComp 3.0
benchmarks.scope: Information judgement, communication, content creation, safety and problem solving. AI competence appears throughout.

benchmarks.name: Nigeria Data Protection Act and GAID
benchmarks.scope: Nigerian primary legal instruments for purpose, necessity, lawful basis, rights and accountable processing. Exercises invite review of applicability in real practice.

progression: Digital practice principles, information governance and telepractice accountability.
Journey mapping, selected WCAG 2.2 task checks and a staffed fallback.
Field-level necessity, meaningful recording choice, protective account habits and incident reporting.
Rule, prediction and generation. Matched checks, evidence scope and reviewer authority.
Source reconciliation, professional reflection, correction and downstream responsibility.
Case states, access matrix, timed handoffs and record reconciliation after an outage.
Measures with denominators, comparable tasks, adoption limits and monitoring.
Options, tabletop exercise, disconfirming tests and a conditional decision.

evidence_checks.metrics: Journal quartiles are 2025 SJR by named category. Judge each study by method, context and results.
evidence_checks.local_ijsds: Issue PDF and IJSDS index inspected. Use Olawumi's situated discussion to frame cultural and language questions. Omit unverified statistics and bibliography assertions.
evidence_checks.depth: Seven guided short courses add applied work to the retained foundation. Field education, supervised practice and full degree or professional accreditation are separate.
